question: In the Frozen Sick adventure, what disease can characters catch in Croaker Cave, and what are its effects?
expected_answer: Frigid woe. DC 11 Constitution save on contact with blue spores. Symptoms appear after 1d4 days: fatigue, chills, blue veins. Speed reduced by 5 feet. Every 10 days, a new DC 11 Con save or take 1d6 Cold damage and speed reduced by another 5 feet. At speed 0, the creature dies.

bm25_simple.answer: Frigid Woe. DC 11 Constitution save on contact with blue spores. Symptoms in 1d4 days: fatigue, chills, blue veins. Speed reduced by 5 feet. Every 10 days, DC 11 Con save or speed reduced by another 5 feet. Speed 0 = death (body turns to ice statue). Cannot be cured by magic, only antidote from Eiselcross ruins. Source: Frozen Sick PDF p.1-2.

bm25_2round.answer: Frigid Woe. DC 11 Con save. Spores from trapped chest in C6 (15-foot cube, dragon face lid). Symptoms in 1d4 days: fatigue, chills, blue veins. Speed -5 ft. Every 10 days, DC 11 Con save or speed -5 ft more. Speed 0 = death (ice statue). No magical cure, only antidote. Source: Frozen Sick PDF p.1, 8-9.
